status: predeclared before any production case was run
decision: Does the plan-view floe DEM with a zero-offset crushing law, a recycling inlet (steady state over 10 ship lengths) and a compliant pack boundary reproduce the Lindqvist level-ice resistance within 15% in the consolidated limit (C=0.90), and does its contact-level energy ledger close?

alternatives.H1_measurement_limited: domain/pack-boundary artefacts caused the earlier 91% shortfall; R/R_Lindqvist -> 1 as C -> 0.9069
alternatives.H2_structure_limited: a plan-view disk pack cannot host out-of-plane bending/submersion, so R/R_Lindqvist stays bounded below 1 at every C

primary_configuration.note: the consolidated limit; the maximum coverage of non-overlapping equal disks is the hexagonal limit 0.9069, so 0.90 is the highest defensible setting and a request above the limit is refused, not clamped
primary_configuration.hull: MT Uikku equivalent transport hull (L=105 m, B=26 m, 18 deg entry)

metrics.resistance: steady-window mean of the hull reaction along the track, with std, SEM, peak and a linear stationarity drift
metrics.energy: per-channel energies (water drag, hull dashpot, hull sliding, floe-floe dashpot, floe-floe sliding, pack wall, heave damping, stored KE/PE, recycled out) plus the ledger residual
metrics.sensitivity: R(C), R(h), R(sigma_c) surfaces plus the declared model choices (pack width, floe size, hull form, time step, seed)

stopping_rule: the case set is fixed by CASE_SPECS and is not extended after a resistance number is seen; no coefficient of the graded ledger is re-tuned after the first standard-case result
exclusions: cases whose wall time would exceed the campaign budget are not silently dropped: the case list is fixed in code and every listed case is reported
controlled_variables: material, friction, hull form, ice thickness (except in the thickness sweep), speed, time step (except in dt_fine)
changed_variables: concentration, thickness, crushing strength, seed, pack width, floe size, hull form, time step
confounders: floe-size polydispersity is geometrically coupled to concentration (a high-concentration field of non-overlapping disks must be nearly monodisperse); the realised spread is reported with every case
the recycling inlet re-injects ice at rest, which is exact only for a stationary far field
the pack boundary is a declared model substitute for the surrounding ice
the resistance is impact dominated, so single-realisation differences below the seed spread are not interpreted
environment: single CPU core per case, torch float64, deterministic seeds; the campaign runs on the 702 cluster (loong64 nodes)
analysis: criteria evaluated by tensordem.ice_transit.campaign.evaluate_criteria (pure function); trends by Pearson correlation and a log-log exponent; uncertainty by SEM over the steady window and by the seed ensemble; no outlier removal
interpretation_limits: agreement with Lindqvist can only be structural because the coefficient values are WITHHELD offline; the broken-ice channel measurements of the source paper are not transcribed, so the absolute DEM level stays WITHHELD against experiment
